# The Rift-Stalker Menagerie — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **CONTRACT** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Mercenary Contracts (pick 2 of 5):** Bounty Hunters: mark 2 enemy units; re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1 against them; +1 CP when one is destroyed · Guerrilla Infiltrators: 2 units gain [INFILTRATORS] and [SCOUTS 6″]; your units count as in Cover against attacks from more than 15″ · Shock & Awe: melee weapons gain [CRASHING], ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT] · Scavenged Grit: UNYIELDING 6+; Class 4–5 units heal 1 MIGHT at the End of Round · Master Tacticians: +1 CP in the Command Phase of Rounds 1 and 3. Any universal archetype (catalogue/unit_archetypes.json) is a legal datasheet at its catalogue price.

**Gamble — Objective Wager** *(risk: objective)*: Before deployment, secretly note one no-man's-land objective. Reveal at the end of Round 4: if you control it, +3 VP; if your opponent does, they score +2 VP.

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Contracts (average of 2 of 5)* — Two contracts out of five ≈ 40% of each.

## Detachment — Free Company

*Balanced mercenaries: take the contracts that fit the mission.*

**Detachment rule:** Professional Soldiers: sign a third contract (3 of 5).

**Enhancements**
- **Veteran's Contract** (+15 pts, Wasteland Warboss): The attached unit has UNYIELDING 6+.
- **Hazard Pay** (+10 pts, Veteran Free-Blades): Re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

**Stratagems**
- **Renegotiate** (1 CP) — *Command Phase, once per battle:* Swap one contract for another.
- **Covering Fire** (1 CP) — *A friendly unit within 6″ is charged:* This unit makes a ranged Retaliation Strike against the charger.
- **Pay the Bonus** (1 CP) — *A unit destroys an enemy unit:* It may make a 3″ move.

## Detachment — Outcast Scavengers

*Salvage crews that strip wrecks and objectives.*

**Detachment rule:** Salvage: when a Class 3–5 unit (either side) is destroyed, place a Salvage marker; a unit that ends a move on it gains +1 PEN on one weapon for the rest of the battle (remove the marker).

**Enhancements**
- **Scrap-Plate** (+10 pts, Line Mercenaries): +1 ARM (to 3+ cap) against PEN 0 and −1.
- **Jury-Rigged Engine** (+10 pts, Armoured Hauler): +2″ MOV.

**Stratagems**
- **Strip It Bare** (1 CP) — *A unit ends on a Salvage marker:* Also heal D3 MIGHT.
- **Makeshift Barricade** (1 CP) — *A unit did not Move:* It claims Cover until the End of Round.
- **Scav-Rush** (1 CP) — *A unit moves toward a Salvage marker:* +2″ MOV.

## Detachment — Monster Hunters

*Specialists who bring down big things.*

**Detachment rule:** Big Game: re-roll Wound rolls of 1 against Class 3–5 units; Fell the Colossus Tactical card scores +1 VP.

**Enhancements**
- **Harpoon-Gun** (+10 pts, Bounty Hunter): +1 PEN with ranged weapons; [HARPOON].
- **Monster-Slayer Charm** (+10 pts, Hired Duelist): +1 Damage on a round he charged.

**Stratagems**
- **Bait the Beast** (1 CP) — *An enemy Class 3–5 unit declares a Charge:* The target may make a 3″ move first.
- **Hamstring** (1 CP) — *A Class 3–5 enemy is wounded:* It suffers −2″ MOV until the End of Round.
- **Trophy** (1 CP) — *A Class 3–5 enemy is destroyed:* Gain 1 CP.
